استقرضن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْرَضْنَ (istaqraḍna) /is.taq.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اُسْتُقْرِضْنَ (ustuqriḍna) /us.tuq.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اِسْتَقْرِضْنَ (istaqriḍna) /is.taq.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
